最近在学习训练角色模型，好繁琐，自己截图，裁图，标注，调参。不过这是一个很重要的技能，特别是很多小众角色没有现成的模型，不过冷门角色图也少，样本不够不稳定，只能发挥我专长凭空造图再揉进模型里了。这次更新是凭空造图的产物之一，和角色本身只能算是神似，不过我很喜欢，目前打算把这些身体特征揉进模型里。用截图训练只能训衣服和脸，生成的身子一言难尽，加上关于身子的提示词又会改变气质，只能试试把身体特征揉进去会不会好些。

Been learning how to train character models lately. So much tedious work... taking screenshots, cropping, tagging, tuning settings.....

Still, it's a pretty important skill, especially since a lot of niche characters don't have ready-made models. The problem is, niche characters also tend to have very little source material, so training can be pretty unstable. Guess I'll have to use my specialty: making stuff up from scratch and somehow mixing it back into the model lol.

This update is actually one of those made-up images. It's more "same vibe" than truly accurate to the character, but I really like how it turned out, so I'm thinking about incorporating these body features into the model.

Training only on screenshots seems only to teach the clothes and face, but the generated bodies are... questionable, to say the least. Adding body-related prompts tends to change the character's overall vibe too, so I guess I'll see if teaching those body features directly works any better.
